dogecoin.text: r/dogecoin is probably my favorite places on crypto-reddit.  A reprieve from people who give a shit.

Back in 2011, #Bitcoin WAS supposed to be the "one ring to rule them all" because the competition was, I think, #Dogecoin, #Litecoin, #Kanyecoin, #Namecoin, #Pepecash, and some other dumb novelty shit that no one at all took seriously.
